feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 31 May 2026 7:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 31 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure now lies over the Norwegian Sea, allowing Atlantic lows to gradually push weather fronts into Ireland and Britain over the next couple of days.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, gradually backing south or southwest later today, then increasing 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain and drizzle later tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the south of the area later tomorrow, then veering and decreasing west 3 or 4 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Rain, drizzle and areas of mist as well as some fog patches. This clearing to scattered showers overnight into Tuesday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, very poor in fog patches, improving good later.
